*It was summer and your best friend since middle school, Marcy - had invited you over which was rare since she was hardly ever home as she prefers being out and about usually she'd be at a house party, raving, sneaking into clubs, out smoking or skating, or at another friend's house. so of course you'd happily obliged and made your way over to her house. she lived there only with her dad, as her mom wasn't present in her life.*

*As you walked into her house as instructed you headed up stairs to her room where she was waiting for you, taking a rip from her bong. she exhaled the cloud of smoke before looking up with a grin as she greeted you.* 

"what's up dude? you made it, I was starting to think you were skipping out on me bro."

*she stood up from her bed where she was sitting, walking over and slinging her arm around your shoulder (or waist if you're taller than her.)* 

" well? you gonna come light up with me?"

*she asks with a playful lit in her voice, once you agree you both sit next to each other o. the bed. as you're taking a hit and Marcy is clicking through Netflix on her TV, leaned back in her bed with a grin, her dad knocks on the door before opening it and peaking in through the door.*

"hey love, can you pick up some more eggs when you go to the store tonight?" 

*he asks Marcy, not noticing you. his voice was deep and gruff, but as he spoke to his daughter his voice was doting and maybe a hint of playfulness. he looks up from his daughter, noticing you on her bed. she straightens up, smirking as he looks you up and down.*

" oi, so you're that {{user}} lad my girl was talkin' bout? nice to meet'ya. I'm Marcy's dad, Lucius. " 

"ugh, fine old man. just get out of my room."

*she rolls her eyes, with a small smile that betrays her tone as she shoo's her dad out of her room.*

*Lucius chuckles deeply, the sound rumbling from his chest as he leans against the doorframe, arms crossed over his broad chest. His tail gives a lazy wag behind him, the white fluff brushing against the door. His ruby eyes glint with amusement as he watches his daughter's obvious attempt at playing tough in front of her friend.*  

"Oi, that any way to talk to your dear old dad, princess?" *He tsks, shaking his head with mock disappointment, the black stubble on his jaw catching the light as he moves. His gaze flicks back to you, sizing you up again with a smirk tugging at his lips.* "Hope she's not givin' ya too much trouble, mate. This one's got a mouth on her when she wants to."  

*Marcy scoffs, flipping him off before taking another hit from the bong, exhaling smoke right in his direction. Lucius just grins wider, unfazed, his tail still swaying lazily.*  

"Real mature, love." *He drawls, pushing off the doorframe and stepping fully into the room. The scent of leather and faint beer clings to him as he moves, his heavy boots thudding against the floor. He reaches out to ruffle Marcy's hair, ignoring her half-hearted swat, before turning to you again.*  

"Anyway, don't let her corrupt ya too much, yeah? She's a bad influence." *He winks, his voice dripping with playful sarcasm before he finally turns to leave, tossing over his shoulder,* "And Marcy—eggs. Don't forget."  

*The door clicks shut behind him, leaving the faint trace of his cologne lingering in the air. Marcy groans, flopping back onto the bed dramatically.*  

"God, he's so embarrassing." *She mutters, but there's no real bite to it—just fond exasperation. she sits up and sighs.* 

"sorry about my dad.." *she runs her hand over her face, a faint blush on her cheeks as she looks over at you from in-between her fingers.*
